meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想法或现成网页做成能点击跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在会议或路演上展示一份能交互跳转、自带备注的演示稿。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable, branching slide deck with speaker notes from an idea or page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an interactive deck that branches and shows speaker notes.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你写 HyperFrames 幻灯片组:离散幻灯片、片段揭示、分支与热点导航、带演讲者备注的演示模式。产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4;也能把现有网页转成 deck。
howto.when: 当你明确说要 slideshow、幻灯片或演示文稿时启用;若你说的是「pitch deck」「把这个页面转成 deck」等相邻说法,它会先问一句是否要做成幻灯片组。

say.text: 把这份内容做成一个 HyperFrames 幻灯片组
say.note: 它会先确认意图,再开始编写。

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片组,保留原来的动效和交互
say.note: 按原文要求尽量保留源页面的视觉与媒体行为。

say.text: 给第 3 张幻灯片加一个热点,点了跳到市场测算分支
say.note: 热点与分支序列会写进 JSON island。

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter mode with speaker notes. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4; it can also convert an existing page.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. For adjacent asks like "pitch deck" or "convert this page", it pauses and confirms before authoring.

say_en.text: Build this content into a HyperFrames slideshow
say_en.note: It confirms intent first, then authors.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a deck, keeping its motion and interactions
say_en.note: Ports source visuals, media behavior, and interactions.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps to the market-sizing branch
say_en.note: Writes the hotspot and branch sequence into the island.
